children: Accenture and Anthropic are partnering to establish a team of embedded evaluators to work alongside Anthropic's internal teams, with each company committing at least $1 billion over five years to AI safety. The evaluators will red-team models, conduct alignment assessments, and test safeguards. Accenture said it is drawing on its acquisition of Faculty, an applied AI company with experience building AI systems for government, defense, and healthcare, including the UK National Health Service's early warning system during the COVID-19 pandemic.
